decisions.statement: An hour with someone at ease is one point.
A stretch is at ease where its safety less its difficulty reaches one level.
A stretch is with someone where that stretch names a relationship.
A stretch naming nobody adds no hours however far that stretch is at ease.
A level given as text is read as the number that text spells.
A stretch missing either level or either time is left out of the sum.
A stretch that earns nothing adds no hours and still makes the day count.
A day no stretch can be read on earns nothing rather than a charisma of zero.
A day is read as holding two hundred stretches at the most.

definition: what Alan has built by hours spent at ease

pointUnit: one hour of a stretch whose safety less its difficulty is at least 1
